info.name: DevTrack
info.description:
Local DevTrack API, grouped by domain (through 014-task-detail-polish).

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:3000`).

**Auth:** HTTP-only cookie `devtrack_session`. Run **auth / Register** or **auth / Login** first. Enable the cookie jar (Settings → General → Cookies). Do not put a bearer token in headers.

**Errors:** `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }`.

**Suggested order:** health → register/login → users/me → create project → members → tasks → labels → comments → activity → dashboard → probes.

**Roles (project-members):** `OWNER` | `EDITOR` | `VIEWER`. Creating owner is always OWNER. Add existing users by email (no invite email). EDITOR: project patch + task writes + label catalog/assign. VIEWER: read/list. Only OWNER manages members and archive.

**Task enums:** status `TODO` | `IN_PROGRESS` | `DONE`; priority `LOW` | `MEDIUM` | `HIGH`. Soft-delete is HTTP DELETE (sets `deletedAt`; no restore).

**Labels (012):** colors `RED` | `ORANGE` | `YELLOW` | `GREEN` | `TEAL` | `BLUE` | `PURPLE` | `PINK` | `GRAY`. Catalog under `/api/projects/:projectId/labels`. Assign via `PUT /api/tasks/:taskId/labels` `{ "labelIds": [...] }` replace-set. Task DTOs include `labels: [{ id, name, color }]`. Optional list filter `labelId`.

**Comments (010):** create/list/PATCH/soft-delete under `/api/tasks/:taskId/comments`. Create = task write; list = task read; PATCH author-only; DELETE author or effective OWNER. Soft-delete hides from list; no restore. Plain text body.

**Activity (011):** `GET /api/tasks/:taskId/activity` → `{ activity }` newest-first. Kinds: `TASK_CREATED`, `TASK_FIELDS_CHANGED`, `TASK_SOFT_DELETED`, `COMMENT_ADDED`. TaskDetail UI omits `COMMENT_ADDED` rows when interleaved with live comments.

item.name: system
item.description: `system` domain. `/health` and `/ready` are public. Probe create/list require a session. Probes are a shared non-product list (no owner). Probe UI was removed from the React app; HTTP remains.

request.description:
Liveness. Does not query PostgreSQL.

**Auth:** none

**200:** `{ "status": "ok" }`

Readiness via the `system` repository.

**Auth:** none

**200:** `{ "status": "ready" }`
**503:** `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`

Create a system probe. Body must be `{}` or omitted.

**Auth:** session cookie

**201:** `{ "id", "recordedAt" }`
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`
**503:** `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`

List probes, newest first.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "probes": [{ "id", "recordedAt" }] }`
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`

item.name: auth
item.description: `auth` domain. Register and login issue `Set-Cookie: devtrack_session` (HttpOnly, Path=/, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age 7 days). Logout revokes that session only.

exec: pm.test('register issues a session cookie or returns an error envelope', function () {

request.description:
Create a user and authenticate. Email stored lowercase; unique case-insensitive.

**Auth:** none

**201:** `{ "id", "email", "displayName" }` + `Set-Cookie`
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`
**409:** `CONFLICT`

exec: pm.test('login issues a session cookie or returns an error envelope', function () {

request.description:
Authenticate. Failed login uses a generic message.

**Auth:** none

**200:** `{ "id", "email", "displayName" }` + `Set-Cookie`
**401:** `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`

Revoke the current session and clear the cookie.

**Auth:** session cookie

**204:** empty body
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`

item.name: users
item.description: `users` domain. Own profile only. No user directory.

request.description:
**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "id", "email", "displayName" }`
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`

Update `displayName` only. Sending `email` is rejected.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** public user DTO
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`

item.name: projects
item.description: `projects` domain. List returns active projects the actor may see (owner or member). Default list excludes archived. Creating actor is `ownerUserId`. Archive/unarchive require OWNER. Create Project saves `{{projectId}}`.

request.description:
Create a project. Also inserts creating OWNER membership.

**Auth:** session cookie

**201:** `{ "id", "ownerUserId", "name", "description", "createdAt", "archivedAt" }`
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`

List active authorized projects (owned or member). No `includeArchived` query.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "projects": [...] }`

Read one authorized project. Archived GET is creating-owner only (members get 403).

**200** / **401** / **403** / **404**

Update `name` and/or `description`. OWNER or EDITOR. Archived → `409`.

**200** / **400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409**

Set `archivedAt`. OWNER only. Idempotent.

**200** PublicProjectDto

Clear `archivedAt`. OWNER only. Idempotent.

**200** PublicProjectDto

item.name: project-members
item.description: `project-members` domain (009-collaboration). Roles: `OWNER` | `EDITOR` | `VIEWER`. Add existing registered users by email. Only OWNER may add/update/remove. List is readable by any authorized member. Saves `{{memberUserId}}` from Add Member.

request.description:
List members for an authorized project.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "members": [{ "id", "userId", "email", "displayName", "role", "createdAt" }] }`
**401** / **403** / **404**

Add an existing user by email. Role must be `OWNER` | `EDITOR` | `VIEWER`. Set `{{memberEmail}}` to a registered user.

**Auth:** OWNER session

**201:** PublicMemberDto
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`
**403:** `FORBIDDEN`
**404:** user/project not found
**409:** duplicate membership

Change a member's role. OWNER only. Demoting/removing the last creating OWNER is rejected by domain rules.

**200:** PublicMemberDto
**400** / **401** / **403** / **404**

Remove a member. OWNER only. Body `{}` or omitted.

**204:** empty body
**401** / **403** / **404**

item.name: tasks
item.description: `tasks` domain (004) + dashboard (008) + label embedding/filter (012). Soft-delete via DELETE. List filters: optional `status`, `priority`, and/or `labelId`. PublicTaskDto includes `labels: [{ id, name, color }]`. Kanban uses PATCH status. Create Task saves `{{taskId}}`.

request.description:
Summary for the caller's authorized active projects. No query params. Pending = TODO+IN_PROGRESS; completed = DONE; overdue = non-DONE with dueDate before UTC today.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "projectCount", "taskCount", "pendingCount", "completedCount", "overdueCount", "projects": [{ "id", "name", "taskCount", "pendingCount", "completedCount", "overdueCount" }] }`
**400:** if unknown query keys
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`

Create a task. Required: `title`. Optional: `description`, `dueDate` (YYYY-MM-DD), `status`, `priority`. Defaults: status `TODO`, priority `MEDIUM`. OWNER or EDITOR. Archived parent → `409`. Response includes `labels` (usually `[]`).

**201:** PublicTaskDto (no `deletedAt`)
**400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409**

query.description: Optional UUID: filter tasks that have this catalog label (AND with status/priority)

request.description:
List non-deleted tasks for the project. Optional filters: `status`, `priority`, `labelId` (single UUID; AND with others). Enable query params as needed. Each task includes `labels: [{ id, name, color }]`. Authorized members may list.

**200:** `{ "tasks": [...] }`

Get one task. Soft-deleted → `404`. Includes `labels: [{ id, name, color }]`.

**200:** PublicTaskDto
**401** / **403** / **404**

Update allowed fields. At least one required. Cannot change `projectId` / `id` / `createdAt` / `deletedAt`. OWNER or EDITOR. Kanban columns call this with `{ "status": "..." }`.

**200** / **400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409** (archived parent)

Soft-delete: sets `deletedAt`, does not remove the row. No restore API. Later GET → `404`. OWNER or EDITOR. Archived parent → `409`.

**204:** empty body

item.name: comments
item.description: `tasks` comments (010-task-comments). Create = task write; list = task read; PATCH author-only; DELETE author or effective OWNER (soft-delete via `deletedAt`). Create Comment saves `{{commentId}}`. No restore. No mentions/rich text.

request.description:
Create a comment on a live task. Required: non-empty `body` (trimmed). OWNER or EDITOR. Also emits `COMMENT_ADDED` activity. Archived parent → `409`/`403` parity with task writes.

**201:** `{ id, taskId, authorUserId, authorDisplayName, body, createdAt }` (no `deletedAt`)
**400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409**

List live comments oldest-first. Soft-deleted omitted. Any task reader (OWNER/EDITOR/VIEWER).

**200:** `{ "comments": [...] }`
**401** / **403** / **404**

Author-only body update. Non-authors (including OWNER/EDITOR) → `403`. Soft-deleted comment → `404`. Does not emit activity.

**200:** PublicCommentDto
**400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409**

Soft-delete: sets `deletedAt`. Author or effective project OWNER. No restore. Already deleted → `404`. Does not emit activity.

**204:** empty body

item.name: activity
item.description: `tasks` activity (011-task-activity). Read-only list. Newest `createdAt` first. Task read authz. Forward-only (no backfill). UI may omit `COMMENT_ADDED` when showing live comments.

request.description:
List activity for a live task. Kinds: `TASK_CREATED`, `TASK_FIELDS_CHANGED` (payload.changes with old/new), `TASK_SOFT_DELETED`, `COMMENT_ADDED` (commentId + bodyPreview). Soft-deleted task → `404`.

**200:** `{ "activity": [{ id, taskId, kind, actorUserId, actorDisplayName, createdAt, payload }] }`
**401** / **403** / **404**

No public write routes for activity.

item.name: labels
item.description: `tasks` labels (012-task-labels). Per-project catalog + many labels per task. Catalog mutate and assign = OWNER/EDITOR (`requireTaskWrite`). Reads = task read. Colors: RED ORANGE YELLOW GREEN TEAL BLUE PURPLE PINK GRAY. Create Label saves `{{labelId}}`. Hard-delete clears assignments. No label activity events.

request.description:
List catalog labels for a project.

**200:** `{ "labels": [{ id, projectId, name, color, createdAt }] }`
**401** / **403** / **404**

Create catalog label. Required: `name` (1–40 after trim), `color` token. Unique case-insensitive name per project.

**201:** PublicLabelDto
**400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409** (duplicate name or archived)

Update name and/or color. At least one field required.

**200:** PublicLabelDto
**400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409**

Hard-delete catalog label and clear all task assignments (Cascade). No restore.

**204:** empty body

Replace-set assigned labels for a task. Body: `{ "labelIds": [uuid, ...] }` (may be `[]`). Labels must belong to the task's project. OWNER or EDITOR.

**200:** `{ "labels": [{ id, name, color }] }` (same shape as PublicTaskDto.labels)
**400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409**
